segment_contamination_dimensions: Sibling 'Office Container' (ID 96540) and 'Mobile Containers' (ID 96541) attract buyers seeking ready-made or pre-built container units as products — not buyers commissioning a bespoke modification and fitout service; names must not imply a finished product sale without a service/conversion component.

Siblings 'Portable Cabin' (ID 35400), 'MS Porta Cabin' (ID 150852), 'Prefabricated Cabin' (ID 135712), 'Modular Portable Cabin' (ID 165827), and related cabin-product siblings attract buyers purchasing a manufactured cabin unit (typically steel/PUF/FRP construction, not ISO container-based); names must not use generic cabin-product vocabulary that would attract non-container portable cabin buyers.

Sibling 'Security Cabins' (ID 42755), 'Portable Security Cabins' (ID 135705), 'FRP Portable Security Cabin' (ID 145135), and 'Prefabricated Security Cabin' (ID 181975) carve out the security/guard cabin buyer segment; the trade name 'porta cabin container' and any guard/security-cabin-first framing are discarded to avoid attracting that buyer persona.
Sibling 'Portable Classrooms' (ID 35057) carves out the educational-use buyer segment; classroom-first naming is discarded.
